structural_composition_rule: Owned event IDs and provenance.source_ids are deterministic unions of already accepted event/anchor/lifecycle/patch evidence. They make no new historical claim.

entries.named_predecessor: Wood-type ear oximeters and Schotz’s 1958 pulsatile near-infrared trace; Minolta’s independent 1973 red-PPG work
entries.material_delta: The 1974 method uses the ratio of red/infrared pulse-related optical changes to estimate arterial saturation, separating the pulsatile component from static tissue absorption.
entries.locator: 1958 Schotz trace and 1973–1975 Aoyagi, Nakajima and Minolta sections
entries.limits: Earlier noninvasive saturation measurement and pulse-wave observation existed; clinical pilot is not routine adoption.

additional_evidence.supports: The review distinguishes the earlier pulse trace and independent Minolta program.

entries.named_predecessor: Zoll external pacing in 1952 and Bakken battery-operated wearable pacemaker in 1957
entries.material_delta: A pulse generator and cardiac leads are implanted within the patient, avoiding an external generator for this specific treatment.
entries.limits: No first electrical cardiac stimulation or lasting success is claimed; the original device failed after hours.

additional_evidence.supports: The first documented patient use and rapid failure are explicitly reported.

entries.named_predecessor: Nylon and meta-aramid Nomex; Soviet 1969 Vniivlon heterocyclic high-strength/high-modulus fibers published 1971
entries.material_delta: PPTA forms a nematic spinning solution that can yield strongly oriented aromatic polymer chains; this is a distinct polymer/process route to high-strength fiber.
entries.locator: Printed pp. 12–13; aramid-vniiv “A HS/HM fiber”; aramid-nrc1994 p. 89
entries.limits: Comparable high-strength Soviet fibers predate 1972. No universal first or direct superiority over Vniivlon is asserted; date of first commercial supply remains disputed.

additional_evidence.supports: The Soviet Vniivlon high-strength alternative is described before 1972.
A 1994 technical report gives a disputed 1970 commercialization date.

entries.named_predecessor: Earlier atactic polypropylene and Phillips’s 1953 crystalline lower-molecular-weight polypropylene disclosure
entries.material_delta: Stereospecific catalysts produced higher-molecular-weight, stereoregular solid resin useful for fiber and molding.
entries.locator: 1953 specification and molecular-weight sections; poly-history 1957 plant
entries.limits: The earlier material was crystalline; litigation did not establish blanket uselessness. Molecular weights vary with process and sample.

additional_evidence.supports: The review describes stereoregular polypropylene and the 1957 Ferrara plant.
A contemporaneous article reports commercial Moplen sale.

entries.locator: Printed pp. 169–172 / PDF pp. 180–183; li-history chemistry and table
